nav.label: Main navigation
footer.rules.bundled: Using the rules built into the app
footer.rules.bundled_failed: Built-in rules · could not fetch newer ones
overview.title: Overview
band.never.title: Not scanned yet
band.never.text: A quick scan looks where files arrive: Downloads, Desktop, Documents, Pictures, Videos, Zalo, USB drives.
band.running.title: Quick scan running
band.defender.text: “{name}” looks suspicious, so Genra is asking Windows Defender too…
band.stopped.title: Scan stopped part way
band.stopped.text: Genra looked at {files} files before stopping and found nothing to deal with. The rest was not scanned.
custom.title: Custom scan
custom.full.hint: Every drive and USB stick, leaving out Windows and installed programs. It can take a while; stop it any time.
band.waiting.title: Waiting for you to let Genra read this folder
band.waiting.text: Your computer is asking whether Genra may read {folder}. Press “Allow” in that dialog to go on; Genra only reads, nothing is sent anywhere.
band.safe.title: Your computer is safe
band.safe.text: Quick scan {when}: {files} files, nothing needs you.
band.safe.full: Whole computer scanned {when}: {files} files, nothing to deal with.
band.safe.folder: {folder} scanned {when}: {files} files, nothing to deal with.
band.safe.folders: {n} folders scanned {when}: {files} files, nothing to deal with.
band.hits.title: {n} things need action
band.hits.promise: Genra cleans it for you, loses nothing, and can undo.
band.hits.suspicious: Genra can move it aside if you want; you can get it back for 30 days.
band.previous.title: The last scan found {n} things to handle
band.previous.text: Scan again to see and clean them. Files already checked are not read again.
hits.title: Files found ({n})
band.previous.listed: The files are listed below. Check each one again, or scan the whole computer again.
history.title: History & undo
history.empty: Nothing yet. Every file Genra checks, moves aside or cleans is listed here, with its undo.
hint.drop: Tip: drop a file on the Genra window at any time to check it.
scan.title: Check a file
scan.drop.title: Drop a file here to check it
scan.drop.hint: The file is not sent anywhere. Excel, Word, PowerPoint (.xls, .xlsx, .xlsm, .doc, .docx, .ppt…)
scan.waiting: Waiting for you to let Genra read this folder
scan.waiting.hint: If your computer shows a dialog asking for access, press “Allow”. Genra only reads the file; it never opens or sends it.
scan.error.title: Could not read the file
scan.error.too_large: The file is over 200 MB; Genra skips it.
scan.error.not_a_file: That is a folder, not a file. Checking whole folders is coming soon.
scan.error.not_allowed: Choose the file again, or drop it on the window.
scan.error.other: Genra could not open this file: {detail}
result.safe.title: This file is safe
result.safe.macro_quiet: Has macros, but they do not run by themselves or reach outside the file
result.safe.allowed: The file is on Genra's safe list
result.safe.not_office: Not an Office file: this version reads Excel, Word and PowerPoint files in depth
result.malware.title: This file has malware
result.title.Kangatang: This file carries an Excel worm
result.title.downloader: This file has a macro that downloads programs
result.suspicious.title: This file needs a look
result.hash.title: This file is suspicious
result.hash.text: The file's hash is on a public malware list. Anyone can add to that list, so Genra does not move the file by itself.
result.does.Kangatang.1: Copies itself into Excel on your computer
result.does.Kangatang.2: Spreads to every Excel file you open afterwards
result.does.Kangatang.3: Turns .xlsx into .xls, which can lose data in large sheets
result.plan: One button, Genra does the rest
result.plan.replace: Replace this file with a clean copy, data unchanged (original kept 30 days)
result.plan.machine: Remove the worm from Excel and clean the other infected files
result.plan.verify: Check the clean copy again afterwards
result.plan.quarantine: Move the file aside; you can get it back for 30 days
result.plan.usb: If the file is on a USB stick: move away the fake shortcuts and show the hidden folders and files again
result.suspicious.advice: If you are not sure who sent it, do not enable macros when opening it.
result.report: Is this file safe? Report a mistake
refused.title: Genra could not clean this file
refused.not_office: This is not an Excel, Word or PowerPoint file, so there is nothing inside to clean.
refused.encrypted: The file is password-protected; Genra cannot read inside it to clean it.
refused.old_macros: The file has old-style (Excel 4.0) macros that Genra cannot remove safely yet.
refused.too_large: The file is too large to clean.
refused.unsupported: Genra cannot yet clean this kind of file while keeping its data.
refused.other: Genra is not sure it can clean this file and keep its data, so it left it alone.
refused.kept: The file is where it was, unchanged. You can move it aside: you can get it back for 30 days.
failed.title: Not cleaned
failed.text: The file is unchanged; nothing was touched. ({detail})
done.title: File cleaned
done.text: Your data is unchanged. The original is kept aside for 30 days.
done.quarantine.detail: Press Undo to get it back any time in the next 30 days
done.verify.detail: The clean copy has no macros or malware
done.tell: Tell the sender to clean their computer too, so the next file is not infected.
done.undone: Undone: the original file is back where it was.
undo.clean_changed: The clean copy was edited after cleaning, so Genra did not delete it. The original is still kept aside.
quarantined.title: File moved aside
quarantined.text: {name} is in Genra's quarantine and cannot be opened. You can get it back for 30 days.
details.title: Details
report.title: Report a mistake to Genra
report.privacy: Only the file's SHA-256, the rule id, the app version, the OS and your note are sent. Never the file.
report.note.placeholder: For example: our office template, used for years
report.done: Sent. Thank you, Genra will look at this file again.
family.script: Script that downloads and runs programs
family.shortcut: Shortcut that runs a hidden command
machine.title: Your computer
machine.startup.empty: Nothing unusual starts with the computer.
settings.title: Settings
settings.privacy.text: Genra reads files on this computer and sends no file anywhere. For a suspicious program, script, shortcut or archive it also asks Windows Defender when Defender is on; Defender may send a sample to Microsoft under its own settings in Windows Security.
settings.send_hashes.text: When Genra finds malware in a file, send its SHA-256 and the rule id (never the file) so Genra learns what is spreading. Off by default.
settings.rules.checked.failed: could not fetch a newer pack
repair.planning: Genra is looking for the worm in Excel and for other infected files…
done.text.machine: Your computer works as before. Your data is unchanged.
done.undone.machine: Undone: everything is back the way it was.
excel.title: Excel needs to close first
excel.ask: Genra will ask Excel to close; if a file is not saved, Excel asks you to save it.
excel.never: Genra never closes Excel while you have unsaved work.
excel.promise: Once Excel closes, Genra carries on by itself. There is nothing else to press.
excel.asked: Asked Excel to close. If Excel asks about saving, answer it; Genra is waiting…
excel.self: Genra is waiting for you to close Excel…
excel.continuing: Excel has closed. Genra is carrying on…
excel.failed: Excel did not take the request ({detail}). Please close Excel yourself; Genra is still waiting.
machine.loading: Genra is looking at your computer…
machine.loading.health: Checking antivirus, updates, the firewall and Office…
machine.loading.startup: Reading the programs that start with the computer and their signatures…
machine.loading.hint: Usually 5–20 seconds; Genra only reads, nothing is changed.
machine.sub.todo: {n} thing(s) worth fixing. Every change can be undone.
machine.sub.ok: Nothing needs fixing. Every change Genra makes can be undone.
machine.error: Could not look at the computer: {detail}
machine.off.done: Switched off “{name}”: it no longer starts with the computer.
machine.fix.done: Fixed: Office no longer runs macros on its own.
machine.startup.more: Show all {n} items that are fine
machine.startup.less: Only items that need a look
machine.startup.fine: {n} items start with the computer, all fine.
machine.guard.missing: this folder is not on the computer
settings.install_id.text: Use this ID to ask for the data Genra received to be deleted.
update.text: A signed Genra update. Genra downloads it, installs it and reopens.
update.failed: The update did not install. Check the connection and try again.
update.dialog.title: Genra AV Updater
update.dialog.headline: Genra AV {version} is available
update.dialog.summary: You have {current}. The new version is signed by Genra; it downloads, installs and reopens by itself, keeping your data.
update.dialog.dismiss: Close, don't remind me about this version
result.plan.traces: If it is running or starts with the computer: stop it and switch those off
done.stopped: Stopped it while it was running
done.startup: Switched off what starts with the computer
done.startup.detail: {n} item(s) will no longer start when you sign in
done.unlocked.detail: {n} tool(s), such as Task Manager, work again
done.shown: Showed hidden folders and files again
done.left.detail: Windows did not let Genra do {n} thing(s). Restart the computer, then scan once more.
done.text.partial: Windows did not let Genra finish everything. Restart, then scan once more to finish.
result.plan.loading: Genra is working out exactly what to clean…
result.plan.excel: Excel has a file open that needs cleaning: Genra will ask you to close Excel first.
message.title: A message for whoever sent the file
message.hint: Edit it if you like, then copy it and paste it into Zalo or an email to them.
message.body: Hi, the file “{name}” you sent me contains {threat}. I cleaned it with Genra AV. Your computer may be infected too and pass it on to the next files you send. Please scan and clean it, for example with the free Genra AV: https://github.com/craft-the-code/genra-av/releases
message.paste: Open Zalo, pick the person who sent the file, paste it into the message box and send.
settings.shell_menu: “Check with Genra AV” when you right-click a file
settings.shell_menu.text: Right-click a file in File Explorer to check it at once. On Windows 11 it is under “Show more options”.
settings.shell_menu.error: Could not add it to the menu: {detail}
settings.guard.text: While Genra is open, every new file in Downloads and Zalo is checked at once, and a USB stick is scanned when plugged in. If nothing is found, Genra stays quiet.
settings.autostart.text: Genra starts in the system tray when you sign in, to guard, without opening its window. Closing the window keeps it guarding from the tray.
settings.online_lookup.text: To check a file, Genra sends the first 5 characters of its fingerprint (shared by about one file in a million), never the file. The match is made on your computer.
